name: TagUI Bricks
notes: GitHub serves the repository as aisingapore/TagUI-Bricks; its eight workflow folders each have a template ZIP in the v1.0.0 release, and the README shows GIF demos for seven workflows and a PNG cover image for Xero Accounting. The Gmail and Microsoft Word steps were built on macOS at 125% and 200% zoom, and their images may need replacing in other environments. The LICENSE file is Apache-2.0.
summary: A set of sample TagUI workflows for websites and desktop apps, such as emailing forex rates through Gmail, OCR on tax notices and filling Word letters, each offered as a downloadable template.
